- [ES2011b:15:59] A locator device separate from the remote will be incorporated into the design, which will operate with radio signal.
- [ES2011b:15:25] Speech recognition will not be used.
- [ES2011b:14:54] The group decided that their target marketing group would be mostly teenagers and young professionals.
- [ES2011b:16:56] There will not be a stand in which the remote is placed when not in use.
- [ES2011b:17:05] The group decided that the locator function eliminated the need for this component. (replaces a remote without a locator function)
- [ES2011b:17:34] The locator function will not involve an LED indicator; the remote will simply emit a sound when located.
- [ES2011b:19:42] The main interface will include a power button.
- [ES2011b:20:02] The main interface will include a scroll wheel function in place of a number pad.
- [ES2011c:18:05] The remote will feature a spongy material.
- [ES2011c:18:46] The fruits and vegetables trend will be incorporated into the design by including fruit colors along with the company colors. (replaces a remote without the corporate image)
- [ES2011c:19:24] The remote will feature a changeable outer casing.
